data.text: SPEC (from plan .agents/drafts/multi-worktree-parallel.md §3/§7): Implement worktree_config() starlark builtin + starkit plugin. worktree_config() is called from the MAIN Tiltfile only, optional overrides: dir (default .worktree), port_range, gateway=True (default False). Plugin feeds TiltfileLoadResult.WorktreeConfig. Discovery is position-based (§2): every subdir of dir containing a Tiltfile is a worktree named by basename; main checkout is 'main'. Two worktrees with same basename -> load error. dir missing/empty -> no worktrees, classic behavior. Escape hatch --worktrees=false -> classic single-Tiltfile behavior. Existing partial impl in internal/tiltfile/worktree/ (state.go, discover.go, validate.go) + TestWorktreeConfig green; complete wiring so TiltfileLoadResult carries WorktreeConfig end to end. Acceptance: starkit fixture tests (internal/tiltfile/starkit/fixture.go patterns) for parse/defaults/errors; go test ./internal/tiltfile/... green; go build ./... green.
